regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, graphical abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and the aggregate chiral Cu-NHC cyanoborylation claim. The graphical abstract is a current reaction-class summary rather than another experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1A(i)
regions.finding: Classified the Pd-catalyzed 26% achiral beta-cyano allyl boronate reaction as cited prior literature, not a current-paper run.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1A(ii)
regions.finding: Classified sequential copper cyanoborylation/hydroboration to a diboryl nitrile as cited prior literature; no current experiment or yield was assigned.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1B and introduction
regions.finding: Classified the authors' chiral Cu-NHC cyanoborylation as a current generic scheme. Generic R groups and catalyst drawing were not treated as an experiment-specific structure.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic/prior drawings omit multiple quantities and operational details.
The publisher's Supporting Information link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper two-column Results and Discussion prose
regions.finding: Mapped the catalyst/base screen, regioisomer formation, reduced loading, less-than-4% further borylation, Table 2 functional-group scope, and Table 3 ligand/temperature/salt conclusions to their row records without creating prose duplicates.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction header and entries 1-14
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization rows independently. The ordered 2.0 mL THF/room-temperature/15 min catalyst-base preactivation precedes addition of 1a/B2(pin)2/NCTS in 8.0 mL THF and a 4 h room-temperature stage; footnote-d 5 mol% overrides apply only to entries 4-6.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 footnotes
regions.finding: Structured 1a 0.5 mmol, diboron/NCTS 1.2 equiv, base 1.4 equiv, catalyst loading, NMR/isolated yield bases, GC-MS regioisomer ratios, and trace outcome. The separate THF charges are not collapsed into an author-reported total volume.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2/Table 3 scope introduction
regions.finding: Linked the prose-defined scope and asymmetric-screen claims to the page-3/4 row records; compact structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

unresolved: Optimization rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and product masses.
Catalyst-mixture component amounts are not separately reported beyond printed CuCl/ligand ratios.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 reaction header, products 2a-2y, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded all twenty-five distinct [(SIMes)CuCl]-catalyzed substrate-scope arrows with shared 0.5 mmol allene, reagent equivalents, 5 mol% catalyst, 10.0 mL THF, room temperature, 4 h, and the displayed isolated yields.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 3 header, ligand structures L1-L12, and entries 1-4
regions.finding: Recorded the first four of twenty independent asymmetric-condition rows; ligand drawings are retained by label and are not machine-verified structures.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left scale-up and Scheme 2 application prose
regions.finding: Recorded the distinct 2.0 mmol/5 mol% (S)-2a scale-up and linked four synthetic applications to their page-4 arrows. The two brominations are separate because their substrates/products differ.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left stoichiometric-reaction introduction
regions.finding: Linked the 1a plus [(IPr)CuB(pin)] stoichiometric experiment to Scheme 3 on page 5. The unquantified precursor-complex preparation statement was not expanded into a fabricated experiment.

unresolved: Table 2 omits workup, purification, masses, atmosphere, and row-specific regioselectivity.
The scale-up does not clarify whether the displayed 10.0 mL THF caption volume was scaled.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 3 entries 5-20 and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all remaining asymmetric-screen rows with row temperatures/times, NMR yields, HPLC er values, 5 versus 10 mol% Cu/L loadings, and entry-19 isolated yield. Entry 19 is merged with the identical standard Table 4 2a result.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 2A-C
regions.finding: Recorded two CuBr2 brominations, one Cu(OAc)2/allyl-alcohol coupling, and one Pd(PPh3)4 Suzuki coupling as four distinct experiments with every displayed dose, temperature, time, yield, er, and E/Z result.

regions.region: page 4 lower Table 4 reaction header, products 2a-2u, and caption
regions.finding: Recorded the standard asymmetric 2a result as the existing Table 3 entry-19 experiment, twenty additional 2b-2u scope rows, and a separate annotated 2.0 mmol/5 mol% 2a scale-up. All isolated yields and HPLC er values were preserved.

unresolved: Scheme 2 applications omit several absolute charges, solvent volumes, workups, masses, yield/selectivity bases, and atmospheres.
Table 4 omits workup, purification, product masses, atmosphere, and regioisomer ratios.
The scale-up solvent-volume applicability remains unclear from the annotation/caption.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 3 stoichiometric arrows
regions.finding: Recorded two ordered experiments: [(IPr)CuB(pin)]+1a in hexane at room temperature for 10 min gives isolated 6 in 86%; 6+1 equiv NCTS in THF at room temperature for 1 h gives 2a and 7 quantitatively.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Figure 1
regions.finding: Classified the copper-alkoxide/boryl, borocupration, cyanation, and transmetallation cycle as a proposed mechanism. I, II, and TS were not treated as preparations.

regions.region: page 5 lower Figure 2 and computational prose
regions.finding: Classified the SIMes-Cu DFT regio-/stereoselectivity pathways as computational mechanism evidence. The 15.7 kcal/mol lowest 1,2-insertion barrier and 20.4/20.6 kcal/mol favored cyanation barriers are retained without assigning experimental yields.

unresolved: Stoichiometric arrows omit absolute complex charges, solvent volumes, atmospheres, masses, and parts of the analytical basis.
Proposed/computed intermediates are not isolated or independently quantified.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left Figure 3 and lower-left DFT discussion
regions.finding: Linked L11 cyanation-transition-state calculations to the existing computational-mechanism record, including the 2.1 kcal/mol (Ra,Ra)-S-TS2 preference. Rendered models and distances are computational evidence, not molecular preparations.

regions.region: page 6 right-column Conclusions
regions.finding: The conclusions summarize the already-recorded catalytic, stoichiometric, and computational findings and add no independent reaction row.

regions.region: page 6 right-column Associated Content and author information
regions.finding: The publisher lists experimental/computational SI and a CIF, but source mapping marks association unestablished. No SI-only procedure, spectrum, or structure was imported; author information is administrative.

unresolved: Computational details referred to SI remain unavailable in the associated workspace.
The online SI/CIF availability statement does not establish a workspace SI association.
